cultural.vision_reason: A strip-woven cotton textile with dark indigo ground, white check bands, and colorful supplementary-weft diamond patterning in the central panel — this narrow-strip weaving technique with polychrome geometric motifs is consistent with West African (Guinea-Bissau region) Papel textile production.

physical.title: textile
physical.summary:
Textile consisting of six narrow strip woven cotton lengths, hand sewn together selvedge to selvedge. Ground weave: plain weave: dyed blue warps and dyed blue and white wefts. This creates a cloth with a dark blue background with bands of weft stripes at either end in white. The cloth is then decorated using supplementary weft and supplementary weft floats. There are white check bands at each end of the textile which are flanked by the white stripes mentioned earlier. The central panel consists of weft stripes of a diamond based pattern in dyed red, yellow, green, blue and white cotton: the colour is consistant across the entire wedt of the fabric. There are also weft check bands at regular intervals in tinsel.

The textile is finished in unwork warps.

physical.title: textile
physical.summary:
Textile consisting of six narrow strip woven cotton lengths, hand sewn together selvedge to selvedge. Ground weave: plain weave: dyed blue cotton warps and dyed blue and white cotton wefts. There are also a number of silver tinsel wefts thorughout the cloth.  This creates a cloth with a dark blue background with bands of weft stripes at either end in white with a silver 'sparkle.' The cloth is then decorated using supplementary weft and supplementary weft floats in white. There is a band of white check at each end of the cloth flanked by the white stripes mentioned earlier. The central panel consists of six warp stripes which are decorated with chains of diamonds consisting of warp lines. These diamonds are backed by black and white check bordered by white warp stripes. There is, throughout the whole cloth, a sprinkling of sparkle created by the small amounts of tinsel woven into the cloth.

The textile is finished in unworked warps.

physical.title: textile
physical.summary:
Textile consisting of six narrow strip woven cotton lengths, hand sewn together selvedge to selvedge. Ground weave: plain weave: white and dyed black warps and wefts. This creates a cloth with a white background with bands of weft stripes at either end in black. The cloth is then decorated using supplementary weft and supplementary weft floats. There is a broad weft band at each end of the textile consisting of two distinct patterns, one based in the diamond shape the other based on triangles. The central panel is divided into warp stripes by lines in black supplementary weft. Within each of these stripes there are clusters of diamonds and clusters of diamonds and triangles which are broken by lines in the weft direction at regular intervals. 

The cloth is finished by unworked warps.

physical.summary:
Textile consisting of six narrow strip woven cotton lengths, hand sewn together selvedge to selvedge. Ground weave: plain weave: dyed blue warps and dyed blue and white wefts. 		The textile is finished with unworked warps.
